name: layerproof-agent-skills
description: Agent skills for interacting with the Layerproof public API (X-API-KEY). Covers workspaces, projects, file uploads, slide deck generation, slide editing, themes, exports, and async job polling.
author: Layerproof

env.name: LAYERPROOF_API_KEY
env.description: Layerproof API key — sent as X-API-KEY header on every request

skills.name: workspaces
skills.description: Create, list, get, update, and delete workspaces. /api/v2/workspaces

skills.name: projects
skills.description: Create, list, get, update, and delete slide deck projects. /api/v2/projects

skills.name: public-files
skills.description: Upload reference files (images, documents) for outline generation. Prepare → PUT → confirm. /api/v2/files

skills.name: project-files
skills.description: Manage files in project directories. Prepare, update, confirm, get, download URL, delete. /api/v2/projects/{projectId}

skills.name: slide-decks
skills.description: Generate outlines, batch/single slide content, transcripts, images, themes, audio, import PPTX. /api/v2/projects/{projectId}/slide-deck/{slideDeckId}

skills.name: slides
skills.description: AI image editing, object removal, text extraction, accept edits, revert, save Konva canvas. /api/v2/projects/{projectId}/slides

skills.name: themes
skills.description: List, get, generate, and apply visual themes to slide decks. /api/v2/themes

skills.name: exports
skills.description: Export presentations as PNG ZIP or PPTX (async). Poll status, get download URL, cancel. /api/v2/projects/{projectId}/exports

skills.name: jobs
skills.description: Poll any async job by activityId. Returns SCHEDULED/RUNNING/PENDING/DONE/CANCELED. /api/v2/jobs

manual.description: Add skill paths to your CLAUDE.md
manual.example:
## Agent Skills

Load the following skill files before performing any Layerproof API operations:

- skills/workspaces/SKILL.md
- skills/projects/SKILL.md
- skills/public-files/SKILL.md
- skills/project-files/SKILL.md
- skills/slide-decks/SKILL.md
- skills/slides/SKILL.md
- skills/themes/SKILL.md
- skills/exports/SKILL.md
- skills/jobs/SKILL.md

manual.description: Reference SKILL.md files with @ in Cursor chat
manual.example: @skills/slide-decks/SKILL.md generate an outline for a product launch
